name: CogNEXUS tool gate
description: Clear OpenClaw host tools through the CogNEXUS Decision API before they run. deny, review, and engine refusals block. review is not OpenClaw /approve.

apiKey.description: Decision API key. Falls back to COGNEXUS_API_KEY on the Gateway. Not a dashboard JWT and not an envelope cnxe_ key.

baseUrl.description: Decision API origin. Falls back to COGNEXUS_API_BASE_URL, then https://app.cognexuslabs.ai.

agentDid.description: agent_did recorded on the sealed leaf when the hook context has no agentId. Default openclaw-gateway.

announce.description: Opt-in (v0.2): announce this instance's identity (agent ids and skill slugs — names only, never content) to the CogNEXUS Agent Wrangler once per process, so unreachable laptop/home-lab instances enter the estate as reviewable discovered rows. Fire-and-forget; never blocks tool gating.

instance.description: Stable instance name used as the announced rows' identity namespace. Changing it re-namespaces the rows — pick one and keep it.

announceAgents.description: Agent ids to announce (names only). Defaults to [agentDid].
